headline: Platform with Highest Average Order Value
question: Which platform has the highest average order value?

approach: Compute average GMV (AOV) per platform from the orders table.
Order the results by AOV in descending order.
Limit to the top platform to answer the question.
report.headline: Platform with Highest Average Order Value
report.intent: Identify the platform that generates the highest average order value.
report.sql: SELECT platform, ROUND(AVG(gmv_eur), 2) AS aov FROM luxexperience.orders GROUP BY platform ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 1;
